About Find Local

How these listings work.

Franklin Navigator uses public-source evidence to build factual local profiles. It does not turn membership into a quality score or ordinary directory rank.

Public-source facts

Identity, category, location and public contact routes appear only when supported by accepted evidence.

Changing details

Profiles show when information was last checked. Hours, availability, prices and other changing details should be confirmed directly.

Free corrections

Anyone can suggest a factual correction. Payment is never required to fix public facts.

Membership stays separate

Membership can add richer presentation and tools, but it does not buy factual accuracy or ordinary directory rank.

Neutral comparison

Comparison uses the same factual fields you select. Franklin Navigator does not create a quality score.

Held records stay out

Candidates that do not meet the current publication rules remain excluded until the evidence is ready.
